title: list_threads input
description: List threads on a board by most recent activity. Filter by following/unread, kind, task state (or open for any unfinished task), assignee, who a task is kept for, or labels (board.task=<state> matches the task state). Returns an as_of cursor for get_changes.

task_state.description: A task state, or open for waiting, ready, claimed and blocked tasks

assignee.description: Who holds the claim (or finished it): principal ID, or 'me'

for.description: Tasks kept for this principal ID, or 'me'

page_cursor.description: Opaque page cursor from a previous result
